technical_read_until_basis: Local candidate recheck deadline aligned to the existing PDP review checkpoint. This is an upper bound for offline research, not a source expiry or accepted use.
source_review_expiry_basis: No accepted review window is established for these L05–L08 capabilities. Source publications and dates remain in the evidence.

provider_identity.qualification: Dated literal names, source identifiers and explicit role/site edges. Deliberate confirmation required. No site, person or affiliation is inferred from a name.

provider_network.qualification: Dated exact, family, named-network, conflict and held observations. Nonmatch stays unknown. Network, appointments and new-patient access require their own evidence.

original_medicare.qualification: Separate source observations of assignment, enrollment, opt-out and hospital identity. Presence does not establish current personal applicability.

pharmacy.qualification: Native plan/NPI/ZIP/retail/mail relationships and separate location observations. No substitution of chain, address, outlet or mail/retail channel.

drug_formulary.qualification: September 2026 CMS tiers and PA/ST/QL flags with separate dated criteria and unit evidence. Supplemental contract/PBP observations cannot silently become segment-exact.

drug_cost_inputs.qualification: Q3 2026 plan-level in-area retail average unit prices and published no-subsidy schedules. Native fees, units, blank and zero values remain distinct.

personal_estimate.qualification: Deterministic multi-drug method, exact quantities, phase/fee rules, scenario validation and acceptance remain open.

exact_store_price.qualification: Exact-product/store price evidence and permitted use are missing.

inherited_stops.policy: Existing acquisition/source-use STOPs remain binding. Retained research observations and gap states are available for internal inspection only. This package performs no acquisition or external requests.

external_evidence: Exact applicable 2026 UHC/Flex and Florida Blue CMS contract/PBP/segment bridges and selected Humana PPO network bridges. Permitted dated roster evidence for omitted sites/specialties and unresolved publisher counts.
Dated targeted exact clinician/site/plan confirmation when consequential, including availability or conflicting observations where relevant.
Aetna/SilverScript dated evidence linking masked-ZIP NPI 1285263780 to the exact dispensing outlet. Never substitute retail NPI 1427893932.
Exact applicable PA/ST version bridges, detailed criteria and explicit physical units where absent. Later documents retain their original applicability.
Permitted dated official-price observations for identical fictional scenarios. Exact-store pricing rights and evidence are a separate dependency.
internal_work: Regional spelling-tolerant candidate search and confirmation flow; exact plan/site resolution, conflict handling and denominator/review fixtures.
Product and outlet confirmation, channel eligibility, report revision binding and correction invalidation.
Deterministic multi-drug estimate, exact arithmetic and reconciliation fixtures; independent source/method/output review and separate participant-scope decision.
Demo adapter, device verification, DQ-26 renewals or disablement, source-control propagation, target-host restore and launch gates.
